svg.title: ActiveFit and WinShot snapshots in Zonogy. A window too wide for its zone slides into view while focused, and back when another window is focused. Window arrangements are saved automatically. Holding Control-Command and tapping Tab shows a timeline of saved window arrangements; releasing the keys restores the selected one, zones and windows. The same window can be part of several window arrangements.
svg.text: A window too wide for its zone slides into view while focused
Hold ⌃⌘, tap Tab to choose, release to restore
A window can be in several window arrangements
